title: The Hawthorn

services.name: Eihwar - Nordic Ritual Nights
services.desc: Fans of Viking music, get ready for the Nordic Rituals of EIHWAR! Hailing from Europe, these feral warriors set Viking dance floors ablaze with their shamanic drums, magical chants, and powerful electro beats. Zach Rushing is just a simple Mississippi boy with a loud mouth and a big heart. He was raised believing in hard work, good friends, and telling it like it is, and he never really grew out of that. Most people know him from his comedy, where he’s built a career on being unapologetically himself. Gogol Bordello’s latest record, We Mean It, Man!, came out in March 2026. For this album, Hütz set out to blend post-punk textures and aggro to Gogol Bordello’s free-wheeling gypsy-punk. 17
